description: The custom filter dialog: an operator with up to two operands, combined with a second optional condition via AND/OR. The operator list is adapted to the column kind (text/number/date). Applying produces a with the matching criteria. All text is localized.

parameters.name: Kind
parameters.description: The column index the filter applies to.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the user applies the custom filter (null clears it).
